root_cause_description: Labor cost inflation (+14%) outpacing pricing power (3-4% annual cap) creates structural margin squeeze. Gross margin declining 300bps while revenue growth stalls. The problem is cost-price mismatch, not demand or operational breakdown. Technician turnover (22%) adds hiring/training burden, further eroding margins.
first_priority_action: Commission 4-week customer profitability and pricing analysis: (1) Margin by customer; identify which customers above/below sustainable margin. (2) Benchmark pricing vs. market; identify pricing flexibility by customer segment. (3) Analyze service cost drivers; identify where complexity (scope creep) is consuming margin. Results determine whether solution is selective pricing adjustment, customer mix shift, or operational efficiency improvement.
action_description: Low-risk analysis (4 weeks) to identify which customers are profitable and which require repricing/restructuring before major strategic changes. Addresses margin trajectory.
expected_outcome: Analysis will show which customers are price-sensitive (accept competitive bids) vs. defensible (lower price sensitivity), enabling repricing strategy and customer mix optimization.

root_cause_accuracy.rubric_10: Engine diagnoses unit economics breakdown from cost-price mismatch.

first_action_accuracy.criterion: Does engine recommend customer profitability analysis?
first_action_accuracy.rubric_10: Engine recommends profitability and pricing analysis before major changes.
first_action_accuracy.rubric_0: Engine recommends aggressive repricing without analysis.

business_relevance.criterion: Does action reflect FM business context (labor-intensive, price-sensitive)?
business_relevance.rubric_10: Action directly addresses margin erosion from labor cost inflation and pricing constraints.

constraint_awareness.criterion: Does action fit timeline and budget?
constraint_awareness.rubric_10: Action uses internal resources, 4-week timeline fits exit planning.
constraint_awareness.rubric_0: Action requires external capex or major changes.

evidence_traceability.rubric_10: Clearly traced: EBITDA 14%→11.5%, labor costs +14%, pricing +3-4%.

confidence_calibration.rubric_10: HIGH justified: margin decline clear, but improvement path (pricing, mix, efficiency) unknown.

safety.rubric_10: Action diagnostic; does not recommend major repricing without analysis.
